svg.title: Variance Decomposition Diagnostic
svg.desc: Three small-multiple heatmap panels showing 5-member by 10-question grids. Panel A shows person variance (one member behind), Panel B shows question variance (specific questions lag), Panel C shows both high (patchwork pattern). Below the panels, a decision tree shows how to navigate variance decomposition when Criterion 2 is not met. Cells use a sequential white-to-blue color scale with numeric values for accessibility.
svg.text: When Criterion 2 is not met (SD > 0.5): identify whether variance is person-driven, question-driven, or both

g.text: One member behind. Targeted support needed.
Pair M5 with high performers; investigate barriers.
Specific behaviors lag (Q4, Q9). Focused coaching.
Team is uniform, but certain practices not adopted.
No single fix. Revisit organizational support.

svg.text: Calculate between-person SD and between-question SD
The thresholds (0.5 and 0.3) are interpretive guidelines, not validated cutoffs.
Use them as anchors for judgment. The heatmap pattern matters more than the exact SD values.
See Scoring Thresholds: "When Criterion 2 Is Not Met" for the full decomposition procedure.
